00043 ChainBaseUGenInternal::ChainBaseUGenInternal(UGen const& input, const int size, const int numChannels) throw()
00044 : ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(1, numChannels-1),
00045   size_(size),
00046   bufferData(new float*[numChannels]),
00047   chain(UGenArray(size_))
00048 {
00049   ugen_assert(size > 0);
00050   ugen_assert(numChannels > 0);
00051   inputs[Input] = input;
00052 }
00053 
00054 ChainBaseUGenInternal::~ChainBaseUGenInternal()
00055 {
00056   delete [] bufferData;
00057 }
00058 
00059 void ChainBaseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00060 { 
00061   const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();  
00062   const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00063   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00064   {
00065     bufferData[channel] = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00066   }
00067   
00068   const int sizeMinusOne = size_ - 1;
00069   for(int link = 0; link < sizeMinusOne; link++)
00070   {
00071     chain[link].prepareForBlock(numSamplesToProcess, blockID, -1);
00072     chain[link].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, -1);
00073   }
00074   
00075   UGen& last = chain.last();
00076   last.prepareForBlock(numSamplesToProcess, blockID, -1);
00077   last.setOutputs(bufferData, numSamplesToProcess, numChannels);
00078   last.processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, -1);
00079 }
